name: Capacitive touchscreen
summary: A glass screen with a grid of electrodes that senses the small current that a finger draws, so that a touch with no force selects an item.
how: Lay a grid of transparent electrodes under the glass.
Read the change of charge at each point of the grid.
Map each touch to a screen position within 1 mm.

origin.note: E. A. Johnson describes a capacitive touch screen at the Royal Radar Establishment.

adoptions.via: The Apple Watch puts a small touch screen on the face, with a digital crown to scroll.
